detailFirewall: Do not add decorative debris, bubbles, fracture sparkle, breakthrough polish or ambience until the naked stage, bore, real auger volume, compressed depth read and camera transition pass the required views.

entries.name: Under-ice cutaway stage root
entries.motion: visibility and bounded stage transition only
acceptanceCues: all cutaway parts share one stable local frame
stage can enter and leave without moving gameplay geometry

entries.name: Existing offshore Frostwell surface context
acceptanceCues: recognizably the same Frostwell facility
no rebuild or identity swap

entries.name: Continuous sea-ice slab and exposed section wall
acceptanceCues: reads as thick volumetric ice rather than a flat plane
surface facility remains grounded above the bore

entries.name: Compressed layered ice geology
acceptanceCues: progress is visible through changing layers
layers remain readable without literal 500m scene height

entries.name: Drilled cylindrical bore and scored wall
acceptanceCues: bore depth tracks the auger tip
no visual drilling through an uncut solid

entries.name: Freshwater basin beneath the ice shelf
entries.motion: slow wave normals and light caustic drift
acceptanceCues: visibly distinct from surrounding ice
approaches the drill tip progressively before 500m

entries.name: Surface drive head and rotation transfer
acceptanceCues: mechanically connects the existing rig to the descending shaft
rotation direction matches the auger

entries.name: Segmented descending drill shaft
acceptanceCues: remains attached at both collars
depth can reach the water layer without scale-stretching

entries.name: Real volumetric helical auger and cutting crown
entries.motion: rigid rotation with shaft plus bounded impact chatter
acceptanceCues: visible helix from side
does not read as the current simple cone
cutting crown meets the active bore face

entries.name: Surface and subsurface pressure fracture network
entries.motion: bounded crack pulses on drill impacts
acceptanceCues: cracks concentrate around the active drill face
no full-slab destruction

entries.name: Cut ice chips and powder transport
acceptanceCues: debris originates at the cutter
Low quality preserves one clear chip cue

entries.name: In-world depth and layer progression cues
acceptanceCues: viewer understands downward progress without relying only on numbers
never implies progress beyond canonical state

entries.name: Approaching-water visual cues
entries.motion: strength rises only near the final depth band
acceptanceCues: water feels increasingly close before breakthrough
does not reveal full water state too early

entries.name: 500m water breakthrough event
entries.motion: replayable presentation triggered after committed 500m result
acceptanceCues: cannot duplicate or lose mission completion
reduced motion uses glow and short dissolve

entries.name: Volumetric section reveal and occlusion controller
entries.motion: short reveal aligned with camera transition
acceptanceCues: ice interior is visible without a fake flat illustration
cut faces remain clean from the approved side

entries.name: Surface-to-side-cutaway cinematic camera
excludes: global board camera authority outside the mission
entries.motion: bounded ease from surface overview to stable side section
acceptanceCues: surface rig and subsurface bore remain connected in one shot
HUD and controller do not cover the drill tip or water layer
interruption safely returns control

entries.name: Section lighting and depth fog
acceptanceCues: form remains legible without emissive wash
snow and ice highlights do not clip

entries.name: Suspended ice dust, tiny bubbles and pressure motes
entries.motion: elapsed-time drift; frozen by reduced motion
acceptanceCues: adds depth without obscuring the auger
Low quality keeps only a few hero motes

entries.name: Reduced-motion and interruption-safe presentation controller
acceptanceCues: closing cannot lose or repeat progress
reduced motion preserves state readability
developer preview can replay every key depth

ambiguities.recommendedDefault: Compress 500m into approximately 12–16 world units with four or five readable geological bands; retain exact numeric truth in canonical UI.
ambiguities.reason: Literal scale would make the phone camera, auger geometry and water approach unreadable.

ambiguities.recommendedDefault: A clean volumetric geological section with a softly luminous edge cap, not a flat 2D diagram and not a transparent whole slab.
ambiguities.reason: This preserves real 3D volume while keeping the bore readable from the mission camera.

ambiguities.recommendedDefault: A broad dark-cyan freshwater lens with warm/cool reflected caustics and a thin separating sediment band.
ambiguities.reason: It reads as a destination and remains distinct from the pale ice and surrounding frozen ocean.

proposedOrder: Representative naked slice: stage, slab, strata, bore, water, shaft, helical bit, camera and section mask
Approve macro side profile and transition
Add lighting, ambience, reduced-motion and interruption handling
Integrate deterministic developer previews and capture all evidence
Run independent visual gate before phone/performance polish
